name: Spherical Harmonic Data Creation and Formatting
aliases: Spherical Harmonic (SH) Data Creation and Formatting
definition: A parallel job that converts raw spherical harmonic coefficients from input splat data into a specific output format (Float32, Float16, Norm11, or Norm6) for storage in a Gaussian Splat asset.
summary: Spherical Harmonic Data Creation and Formatting converts raw SH coefficients into a specific binary format for Gaussian Splat assets, focusing on final serialization into a contiguous byte array rather than coefficient interleaving.
